# `<util/args.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Small command-line argument helpers.

```c
#include <util/args.h>
```

## Structures

### `ArgSpec` { #argspec }

One accepted option; an array of these ends with an entry whose `name` is NULL.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `const char *` | Long name without dashes, e.g. "verbose". |
| `shortname` | `char` | Short flag, e.g. 'v'; 0 if none. |
| `has_arg` | `int` | 0 for a flag, 1 if the option takes a value. |
| `help` | `const char *` | One-line description for ArgsUsage(). |

### `Args` { #args }

Result of ArgsParse().

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `argc` | `int` | Argument count, including the program name. |
| `argv` | `char **` | The argument strings. |
| `positionals` | `const char *` | Arguments that are not options or option values; at most 16 kept. |
| `positional_count` | `int` | Number of entries in `positionals`. |

## Functions

### `ArgsParse` { #argsparse }

```c
int ArgsParse(Args *out, int argc, char **argv, const ArgSpec *spec);
```

Collects the positional arguments, skipping options and their values.

Options are recognised (so their values are not taken as positionals) but not stored; query them with ArgsHas() / ArgsGet(). Unknown long options are ignored.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `out` | out | Filled with argc/argv and the positionals. |
| `argc` | in | Argument count. |
| `argv` | in | Argument strings. |
| `spec` | in | Accepted options, ending with a NULL `name`. |

**Returns:** 0, or -1 if an option that takes a value is the last argument.

### `ArgsHas` { #argshas }

```c
int ArgsHas(const Args *args, const char *name);
```

Tells whether an argument string appears on the command line.

Compares whole argv entries, so pass the option as typed, e.g. "--verbose" or "-v".

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `args` | in | Parsed arguments. |
| `name` | in | Exact argument string to look for. |

**Returns:** 1 if present, 0 otherwise.

### `ArgsGet` { #argsget }

```c
const char * ArgsGet(const Args *args, const char *name);
```

Returns the argument that follows `name` on the command line.

Compares whole argv entries, so pass the option as typed, e.g. "--out".

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `args` | in | Parsed arguments. |
| `name` | in | Exact argument string to look for. |

**Returns:** The next argument, or NULL if `name` is absent or last.

### `ArgsUsage` { #argsusage }

```c
void ArgsUsage(const char *progname, const ArgSpec *spec);
```

Prints a usage line and one line per option to stdout.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `progname` | in | Program name, usually argv[0]. |
| `spec` | in | Accepted options, ending with a NULL `name`. |
